name: Distal Humerus Fracture in Adults
definition: Fracture of the distal humerus in adults, often intra-articular and requiring restoration of elbow congruity and stability.

investigations.principle: Radiographs are first-line; CT defines articular morphology for surgical planning.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, occult injury, postoperative or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Most displaced intra-articular adult fractures require fixation or arthroplasty in selected older patients.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kurpara-bhagna phenotype may be documented after modern stabilization.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the distal humerus in adults, often intra-articular and requiring restoration of elbow congruity and stability.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, respiratory distress, progressive neurological deficit, open injury, severe deformity, infection or other listed red flags.
